name: Avrana Design Foundation tokens
note: A specification, not a runtime dependency. Nothing imports this file at run time. Each product keeps its own implementation (Party: web/src/party.css; Media: its stylesheet; owner app: a Flutter ThemeData) and maps to these names. The Party repository holds the source copy; the Media repository mirrors it byte for byte (see MIRROR.sha256).

space.unit: px at a 16px root; write rem in CSS, logical pixels in Flutter

target.note: 44 CSS px is the floor on the web (WCAG 2.5.5, Apple 44pt). 48 is the default for primary controls and the floor in Flutter and Android (Material 48dp).

window.note: Material 3 window size classes, used as names. Design from 360 wide. A product may place its own breakpoint inside a class when its content needs it.

motion.status: proposed; the Party brief section 29 leaves exact timings and easing undecided
motion.reduced: no movement or scaling; a state change may cross-fade for at most the short duration or switch instantly

roles.surface_low: one quiet step above the ground (notices, tiles)
roles.surface_raised: a clearly raised surface (fields, selected segments, cards)
roles.on_surface_muted: secondary text; at least 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on
roles.on_surface_faint: quiet labels and counts; still at least 4.5:1
roles.outline_quiet: dividers between content; decorative, never the only edge of a control
roles.outline_control: the resting edge of anything pressable or typeable; at least 3:1
roles.action: fill of the one main action in a region
roles.accent: selection, focus and links where the theme has an accent; null where it does not
roles.selected: the tint or treatment of a chosen item; always paired with a second cue
roles.focus_ring: the keyboard focus indicator; at least 3:1 against what is around it
roles.status_ok: success; always beside a word or icon
roles.status_warn: warning; always beside a word or icon
roles.status_error: error; always beside a word or icon
roles.status_info: neutral information; always beside a word or icon
roles.scrim: what dims the page under a modal surface

party.direction: approved 2026-10-05 (UX/UI product brief); console-inspired, restrained monochrome shell, Atomic Purple as a subtle translucent accent

color_notes.status_ok: source is oklch(76% 0.11 158); hex is the sRGB conversion
color_notes.status_info: source is oklch(74% 0.085 250); hex is the sRGB conversion
color_notes.material: Party only: the smoky violet of bars, the drawer and sheets

type.interface: Plus Jakarta Sans (SIL OFL 1.1), bundled; system sans until it loads
type.brand: light Helvetica where installed, Plus Jakarta Sans Light elsewhere; temporary, for the words Avrana Party only
type.code: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

shape.elevation: flat; lines and tone, no shadows

media.direction: approved 2026-10-11 (Media 2.0); monochrome, editorial serif, the Title Card

color_notes.outline_quiet: 2.3:1 on black: dividers only (the Interactive Edge Rule)
color_notes.outline_control: the accessibility adaptation that lets the approved palette pass WCAG 1.4.11
color_notes.accent: the No Accent Rule: emphasis is inversion, size and position

type.interface: Times New Roman, Times, Liberation Serif, Tinos, Noto Serif, serif
type.brand: the same serif, tracked 0.34em, in two fixed sizes
type.code: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace; copyable strings only

shape.elevation: flat; 1px rules and inversion, no shadows
